Job Title: Healthcare Administrative Virtual Assistant
- ABA Therapy

Position Type: Part-Time (20 hours per week)

Work Hours: 10:00 AM
- 2:00 PM EDT

Work Days: Monday
- Friday

Salary: 5-6 per hour, depending on experience

Job Code: SL-ATS

Workplace: Remote

Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines
key_responsibilities:
1. Medicaid Authorizations (Top Priority)
- Track Medicaid authorizations, monitor expiration dates, and follow up on pending approvals.
- Help ensure clients have active authorizations before scheduled therapy sessions.
- Maintain organized authorization records and communicate outstanding requirements.
- Previous Medicaid authorization experience is preferred but not required; training will be provided.

2. EHR Documentation & Administrative Follow-Ups
- Enter therapist-provided progress notes into Omni Practice following established procedures.
- Organize client records, upload documents, and track missing paperwork.
- Follow up with therapists and practice leadership regarding pending documentation, authorizations, and incomplete tasks.
- Maintain accurate records and ensure administrative deadlines are met.

3. Therapist Onboarding & Compliance Management
- Assist with onboarding new therapists and collecting required documents.
- Track training requirements, certificates, and annual compliance updates.
- Monitor missing or expiring documents and coordinate necessary follow-ups.
- Training will be provided for onboarding and compliance processes.

4. Claims, Billing & Payroll Administration
- Assist with claims processing, billing follow-ups, and payment-related concerns.
- Coordinate with case managers to resolve outstanding billing issues.
- Organize therapist session information needed for payroll preparation.
- Maintain accurate billing and payroll-related records.

5. Email & General Administrative Support
- Respond to routine emails and coordinate with therapists and case managers.
- Assist with administrative matters involving Wayne County and other service areas.
- Provide regular updates on pending tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups.
- Help address existing administrative backlogs and maintain organized workflows.

6. Future

- Handle inbound and outbound phone calls as needed.
- Provide additional ABA-related administrative support once the initial backlog has been addressed.

Top 3 Priorities
- Medicaid Authorizations: Track authorization statuses, expiration dates, and pending approvals to help prevent interruptions in therapy services.
- EHR Documentation & Administrative Follow-Ups: Maintain accurate records in Omni Practice and consistently follow up on incomplete documentation and outstanding tasks.
- Therapist Onboarding & Compliance Management: Assist with onboarding requirements, certifications, training records, and annual compliance updates.

Experience Requirements
- Previous healthcare administrative experience is highly preferred but not mandatory.
- Experience with Medicaid authorizations, claims, billing, or insurance follow-ups is an advantage.
- Familiarity with EHR/EMR systems is preferred; experience with Omni Practice is a plus but not required.
- ABA therapy or behavioral health administrative experience is an advantage.
- Previous virtual assistant experience is preferred but not mandatory.
- No medical degree, clinical license, or professional healthcare certification is required.
- Must have relevant administrative experience and be willing to learn client-specific healthcare workflows.

Basic Requirements
- Must be proficient in speaking and writing English clearly and professionally.
- Must have relevant administrative, documentation, or coordination experience.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately monitor deadlines, authorizations, and records.
- Highly organized, proactive, and capable of managing tasks independently without constant supervision.
- Patient, compassionate, and supportive, with the ability to provide gentle reminders and help practice leadership stay accountable.
- Resourceful and comfortable coordinating with therapists and case managers across multiple counties.
- Strong communication skills, including providing regular updates and following through on outstanding requirements.
- Understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements.
- Willingness to learn new systems and processes using client-provided training and an operations manual.
- Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance background check before onboarding (mandatory).
- Must be available for video meetings with the camera on when needed.

Technical Requirements
- Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
- Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
- Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
- Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
- Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.
- Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
- Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
- HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
- Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
- Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client's needs and schedule.
- Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
- Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
- Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.
